title: Public share RLS and current-user helpers expose public trip rows beyond token holders
source: anon/authenticated Supabase public table access and authenticated trip API callers
broken_control: public RLS allowed any is_public/share_token row; current-user helpers lacked explicit user_id filters; share mutation pre-read could return another public trip token
impact: enumeration of public shared trips, share tokens, origin metadata, and stops beyond intended token possession

title: Service-role conditions sync failed open when CRON_SECRET was unset
source: unauthenticated POST to /api/conditions/sync when service role is configured and CRON_SECRET is missing
broken_control: authorization check only ran when expected secret was truthy
impact: public service-role insert into resort_conditions and write amplification

title: Spoofable forwarded IP headers bypassed public API rate limits
source: anonymous requests with attacker-chosen x-forwarded-for values
broken_control: rate-limit keys trusted forwarding headers by default and used process-local buckets
impact: model quota abuse for Gemini-backed routes and unbounded bucket growth

title: Oversized JSON bodies were parsed before schema bounds
impact: memory/CPU exhaustion before Zod limits could reject hostile payloads

title: Gemini prompt included origin-derived drive distance despite anonymized prompt claim
source: normal recommendation requests with home coordinates
broken_control: sanitized request omitted exact origin but serialized the full localRecommendation with Drive fit factors
impact: external AI provider received approximate origin-derived distance and drive-time signals

title: Raw query error rendering could disclose provider details and throw on malformed encodings
source: attacker-controlled error query values and raw provider/database error redirects
broken_control: decodeURIComponent was called during render and detailed errors were reflected
impact: request-level page crash and implementation/account-state detail disclosure

title: Share toggle coercion and unbounded resort ids weakened request validation
broken_control: z.coerce.boolean() treated string 'false' as true; resort ids lacked max bounds/existence checks before insert
impact: malformed share requests could keep/publish links; bad stop ids could leave failed save state after parent insert

title: Authenticated users can still save schema-valid self-owned generated trip content
broken_control: no signed server-generated recommendation id binds save to a previous recommend response
impact: self-owned trip history/product-integrity tampering; no cross-user access under RLS
